initial_application: The Jira comments point to HL7/fhir PR #1043. additional_context: PlanDefinition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current active source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml definition for PlanDefinition.goal.target.detail[x] already includes the requested examples. The same 2020 implementation commit also handled nearby pharmaceutical-quality PlanDefinition issues FHIR-27034 and FHIR-27037 through FHIR-27041, but this audit decision is only for FHIR-27042. Searches of local Zulip and Confluence indexes found no directly relevant community discussion or conflicting later decision for FHIR-27042.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the build-scope StructureDefinition source already satisfies the issue, and generated-looking diagram artifacts do not need independent edits when the authoritative source is correct.
